name: @cloudsforge/emberkin-assets
description: The Emberkin art set, and the run that produced it. Images plus a provenance manifest; the generation engine lives in the sibling studio service and the art specification lives in the upstream game content, and neither is duplicated here.
_noDependencies: This package has no dependencies and no node_modules of its own, on purpose.
generate.ts imports four modules from ../studio/src — backend, specs, sizing and the licence
constant from assets — and plan.ts reads four JSON files from ../kindred-upstream/content.
All of them are dependency-free, so nothing has to be installed to read them; what the studio
modules encode is every verified fact about the FLUX 2 Pro endpoint, and what the content
encodes is the art specification for all fifty Kin. A second copy of either in this
repository would be a second place for it to rot.
The consequence is that this repository is NOT self-contained: a RUN needs the sibling
checkouts beside it. The ARTEFACTS are self-contained — the PNGs, MANIFEST.json and PLAN.json
carry everything needed to audit what was made and from what. That is the same trade
normalise_ground.py and verify.py's CVD table are pure standard library, so they run in CI.
derive.py and sheet.py need Pillow. Not sips: design-system.md section 7 item 3 names sips as
the reason the estate's resize step exists on exactly one laptop.

scripts._run: Run from the studio workspace so tsx resolves out of its node_modules.
